content: Need: calibration-readiness cannot accept observed evidence because origin is neither schema-backed nor traceable. Intent: define first-class Evidence Origin records and resolvable links for decision outcomes and calibration cases, while preserving example-only boundaries. Context: QIF v0.6.26 structurally validates four package types but CRD-ORIGIN is impossible to satisfy through valid packages. Exclude suite-health, uncertainty, and framework-learning features from this release.
